name: Extreme deconvolution
model_likelihood: p(v)=sum_j alpha_j N(v|m_j,V_j); w_i=R_i v_i+Gaussian noise with known S_i
prior: Optional normal-Wishart priors for means and precisions, and Dirichlet prior for mixture weights
inference_algorithm: EM using latent true values and component labels; optional fixed-K split-and-merge search
estimand: Maximum-likelihood or regularized MAP point estimate of the underlying density and its mixture parameters
data_input: Individual noisy projected vectors; observation-specific projection matrices and known noise covariance matrices
tunable_settings: Number of components K; conjugate-prior hyperparameters (mhat, eta, omega, W, gamma); covariance regularization W=w I; cross-validation choices; split-and-merge search depth C
